title: Classy Stay only 2 Miles from Downtown - Sleeps 12
description:
Welcome to The Nashville House!
Located just 2 to 3 miles from downtown attractions like Nissan Stadium, Broadway, The Gulch, and Ryman Auditorium, this spacious home accommodates up to 12 guests.

Enjoy two master bedrooms—one upstairs and one downstairs—and a bunk room with four cozy double beds and a twin futon, perfect for families or friends.

With its prime location and thoughtful amenities, The Nashville House is the ideal base for exploring Music City. We can’t wait to welcome you!

The space
Experience blazing-fast fiber internet and TVs equipped with Roku for your entertainment needs.

Enjoy the convenience of a quick Uber ride to downtown, located just 2-3 miles away—perfect for those who thrive in the heart of the action while having the comfort of home close by.

Nestled in one of Nashville's rapidly evolving neighborhoods, adjacent to Fisk University, this area beautifully blends the charm of historic roots with modern innovation. Our sense of community and connection with our neighbors truly enriches the experience.

We’re eager to share the hidden gems of Nashville, showcasing the city's vibrant culture beyond the typical tourist spots.

Situated only 2.5 miles from Downtown, The Gulch, and the iconic Ryman Theatre, and just over 2 miles from the scenic Centennial Park, you’ll find everything you need right at your doorstep!

Other things to note
Close proximity to many local attractions, including:
2.0 miles from beautiful Centennial Park
2.5 miles from the historic Ryman Theater
2.5 miles from Downtown and The Gulch
